close_reason: Extracted check_issuer_linkage helper (RFC 5280 §6.1.3(a)(2)). working_issuer_is_san_identity assignment remains in chain_walk per design §7 critical preservation requirement (verified at line 3252). All 262 tests pass.
description:
## What

Extract §6.1.3(a)(2) DN linkage / SAN-identity exception check (lines 2154–2166) into `pub(crate) fn check_issuer_linkage(cert: &Certificate, working_issuer_name: &Name, working_issuer_is_san_identity: bool, index: usize) -> Result<()>`.

## Risk

Low — but with a critical preservation requirement.

## CRITICAL note (PKIX-als9 design §7)

The assignment `working_issuer_is_san_identity = cert_has_san_identity(cert)` (line 2666) MUST stay in chain_walk, NOT move into the helper. PKITS does NOT test SAN-identity propagation across multiple intermediates. If the assignment moves, the §4.2.1.6 SAN-identity exception breaks silently for chains where the issuer (not the leaf) uses SAN.

## Acceptance

- New helper.
- chain_walk calls helper at the existing call point.
- Code review confirms `working_issuer_is_san_identity` assignment remains in chain_walk loop body.
- Tests + clippy clean.
- No behaviour change.
